text:
Depending on how much time has passed since they requested the deposit you have 2 options.
* You can try and challenge their decision.
* You can request to lower the amount of the deposit.
To challenge the decision you will likely need a lawyer, which will cost between 5 to 20,000.
To just try and lower the amount no lawyer is needed (although of course it can help but defeats the purpose as it's expensive).
You will need to state why you can't afford it and add proof like payslips and bank account statements.

To appeal the decision you have 21 days, so I don't know how much time you have left.

Note, we had tried to lower the amount but in the end ended up paying the full amount requested.
We had to write a letter stating we were canceling the request to lower the amount.
Good luck 🙏💞🙏
